ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white/off-white) across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the central peduncle and leading edges. Left lobe distal area exhibits white mottling with dense black speckling. Right lobe distal two-thirds is predominantly white, containing a distinct dark elliptical focal spot located approximately 85% horizontally from the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 148 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with approximately 12-15 distinct peaks per lobe; pixel-amplitudes range from 3 to 12 pixels along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex parabolic curves along the leading edge, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized brownish-grey high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) present on both distal tips, measuring approximately 40-60 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical low-intensity grey lines (rake marks) observed in the high-intensity white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustations on lateral tips; one prominent dark elliptical mark on the white distal region of the right lobe.
